resource.name: Military CDL test-waiver options
resource.description: Military driving experience may help you qualify for a CDL test waiver. A temporary FMCSA waiver may extend the qualifying military-experience period where the state adopts it. Ask your state DMV whether a current waiver applies to your record and which application documents and tests are required. A military license is not an automatic civilian CDL, and a test waiver does not promise free training. Check VA training benefits separately before enrolling.

history.title: Military CDL waiver: check state rules
history.sum: FMCSA issued a temporary military CDL waiver. It allows participating states to use a longer period of qualifying military driving experience, not simply time since separation. Ask your state DMV whether a current waiver applies and what documents and tests it requires. A waiver is not automatic CDL approval or a promise of free training.

wisconsinOptional.summary: Military driving experience may help with a Wisconsin CDL application. Ask Wisconsin DMV whether a current FMCSA waiver applies to your record.
wisconsinOptional.caveat: State participation, driving experience, timing and other licensing rules still apply. Do not assume Wisconsin adopted a temporary federal extension.
